items.name: Aarhus Spring 2019
items.information:
Dette vil være den første konkurrence i Aarhus området efter mere end 6 år! Vi håber på, at se mange af jer til stede. Der er mulighed for gratis overnatning i lokalet. Læs mere på [denne fane](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2019#8436-accommodation) om dette.
______
This will be the first competition in the Aarhus area after more than 6 years! We hope to see a lot of you present. There is the option of free accommodation at the venue. Please read more on [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2019#8436-accommodation) about this.

items.name: Anaadyanta Cube Open 2019

venue.name: NITTE Meenakshi Institute of Technology
venue.address: NITTE Meenakshi College Rd, BSF Campus, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India

items.information:
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event.
Additional information will be provided in the tabs.

items.name: CubingUSA Oregon Championship 2019

venue.name: [Oregon State University Memorial Union](http://mu.oregonstate.edu/)
venue.details: The competition will be in the OSU Memorial Union Horizon Room (49), located in the East section on the mezzanine level.

items.information: **Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Responsibilities" tab.** This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition.
